description: This Kotlin source file defines the DashboardFragment class, which is a UI component for an Android application. It manages user interactions for a calculator dashboard, including input fields for operands, operation buttons (add, subtract, multiply, divide), and display of results and errors. It also observes a ViewModel for data updates.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a calculator dashboard with input fields, operation buttons, and output views, and manages interaction with the associated ViewModel.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up LiveData observers for ViewModel data, and configures button click listeners for calculator operations and clearing inputs.

methods.name: currentA
methods.description: Retrieves the current text from the first operand input field.

methods.name: currentB
methods.description: Retrieves the current text from the second operand input field.
